posts.text: I was with a great group of DFLers in Bemidji. Across Minnesota, people are organizing, talking to their neighbors, and bringing people together for a better future for all of us.

Incredible bravery and calm under pressure shown by St. Paul Fire Captain Brian Buxton rescuing DNR Officer Annette Schlag. It’s a powerful reminder of the skill, training, and teamwork our first responders use to keep us safe.

Video

We broke ground on the Highway 5 Improvements Project, which will add two lanes between Victoria and Chanhassen and greatly help locals with the increasingly popular U of M Arboretum traffic. I pushed for federal funding for this project along with Rep. Emmer, former Rep. Phillips & Sen. Smith to reduce congestion, improve safety, and support one of the fastest-growing areas of our state.

Last year, we passed my major bipartisan legislation with Sen. Ted Cruz to take on the brutal sharing of nonconsensual sexual images, real or deepfake. Tragically, a number of kids committed suicide over the sharing of these. 

Good news: The first conviction under this law was just secured of an Ohio man who victimized multiple people with his creation of pornographic deepfakes online.

One good story to start the day…

Dog roaming highway rescued after construction crew feeds her, builds her a hut washingtonpost.com/lifestyle…

In Eden Prairie with Rep. Morrison and local leaders to tour the new Mobile Command Center. I worked with Sen. Smith & former Rep. Phillips to secure federal funding for this critical project that will improve real-time coordination in emergencies and help first responders keep people safe.

A touching tribute to an incredible mom and late wife of NASA Commander Wiseman.

The astronauts on Artemis II honor Carroll Wiseman, who passed away from cancer, by naming a lunar crater after her.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

In an emotional moment broadcast live from the Orion spacecraft, the Artemis II crew chose to name a Moon crater “Carroll" after commander Reid Wiseman's wife, who died of cancer in 2020.

“It's a bright spot on the Moon. And we would like to call it Carroll."

Video
  





—

At the Tate family farm near Cannon Falls to talk about rising fertilizer costs hurting farmers in the wake of the war in Iran and this administration’s tariffs.

I’ve introduced bipartisan bills to increase price transparency and expand domestic production so farmers have the certainty they need.

Video

Congratulations to Judge Chris Taylor, Wisconsin’s newest Supreme Court justice!

An incredible victory — and another example of voters rejecting the chaos and damage of the Trump administration.


CNN (@CNN)

Judge Chris Taylor will win a seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court, CNN's Decision Desk projects, expanding the liberal majority on the panel in a key battleground state. cnn.it/4mdJn2u

Trump said today that “a whole civilization will die tonight.” 
This is insane. 
He is openly threatening massive escalation in Iran. Congress needs to immediately vote to put a stop to this. It is a constitutional duty to vote on war powers and both sides should demand this.

Great to be at Mesabi Metallics on the Range. Opening soon and employing hundreds of workers, it will be the first taconite mine to open in Minnesota in nearly fifty years.
mesabitribune.com/news/klobu…

In Bemidji, it’s remarkable to see how the community has come together and rebuilt after last year’s storm.

Thanks to the hard work of so many, Bemidji is standing strong and open for business.

bemidjipioneer.com/news/thro…

Wonderful to see the love and support for Savannah Guthrie on her return to the Today Show as we continue to keep her mom Nancy and their whole family in our prayers.

Video

Great to be at the University of Minnesota Duluth where incredible work is being done to improve treatment of Alzheimer’s and dementia.

I introduced a bipartisan bill to provide additional training for primary care providers because they are a key part of early detection.

Video

I met with workers and local leaders at Mesabi Metallics in Nashwauk — in a few months, it will become the first taconite mine to open in Minnesota in nearly 50 years. This is good news for the Iron Range, creating good-paying union jobs and new opportunities for working families.

Thinking of Tom and his family tonight on the loss of his mom Patsy. She had a big family including many many grandkids and more who loved her. 🙏


Tom Emmer (@GOPMajorityWhip)

My mom, Patsy, decided today was her day to rise too. She passed peacefully this morning. I can see her right now smiling in the embrace of her love and my father, Tom, and my sister, Bridget. Our time together never was and never will be enough. Love your families today more than ever. On behalf of my brother Jack and s

The sun is shining across Minnesota today for Easter morning. A day of faith, family, and reflection. Always remember my mom singing Easter hymns in the church choir and her bunny breads at dinner. And dad? He always liked a good Easter afternoon hike, even in the cold! 🙏 ☀️ 🪺
